correctness.rationale: At the logarithmic-mean integer tie the radial gamma-spectrum has an isolated double maximum. Coherent-state trace-norm differentiation gives the exact projected perturbation matrix [[alpha*tau,gamma*conjugate(delta)],[gamma*delta,0]]. A nonzero spectral gap and the Schur complement bound the influence of the other Fock modes by O((|tau|+|delta|)^2). The domain area is exactly pi*w and Weyl translation covariance proves common-center invariance. Direct independent polar quadratures passed 92 numerical checks, including the off-diagonal derivative and second-order convergence.

value.rationale: The natural canonical Gaussian localization family consists of two circular boundaries at exactly fixed area. Every consecutive top Hermite collision is classified by one explicit concentric parameter and a uniform two-center cone; the sharp modulus of the eccentricity derivative quantifies a genuine spectral instability that is absent for rigid translations. This is a complete geometrically meaningful local classification, rather than a change of notation, a trivial negative check or an arbitrary small-sample number.
